keywords.indexterm: warning and indicator lights indicator lights

sectiondiv.p: When charging the high voltage battery.
When the vehicle is ready to be driven.

li.p: ON: Normal driving is possible.
OFF: Normal driving is not possible, or a problem has occurred.
Blinking: Emergency driving.

sectiondiv.p: When the ready indicator goes OFF or blinks, there is a problem with the system. If this occurs, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
When Battery Conditioning Mode is activated.

li.p: Once you set the EV Button to the ON position.
It illuminates for approximately 3 seconds and then goes off.
When there is a malfunction with the ESC system.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) OFF indicator light

li.p: Once you set the EV Button to the ON position.
It illuminates for approximately 3 seconds and then goes off.
When you deactivate the ESC system by pressing the ESC OFF button.

sectiondiv.ph: This indicator light illuminates for up to 30 seconds:

li.p: When the vehicle detects the smart key in the vehicle properly while the EV button is POWER ON.
At this time, you can start the vehicle.
The indicator light goes off after starting the vehicle.

sectiondiv.ph: This indicator light blinks for a few seconds:

li.p: When the smart key is not in the vehicle.
At this time, you can not start the vehicle.

sectiondiv.ph: This indicator light illuminates for 2 seconds and goes off:

li.p: When the vehicle can not detect the smart key which is in the vehicle while the EV Button is POWER ON.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
When the battery of the smart key is weak.
At this time, you can not start the vehicle. However, you can start the vehicle if you press the EV Button with the smart key. (For more details, refer to ).
When there is a malfunction with the immobilizer system.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

sectiondiv.p: When the smart key is not in the vehicle and any door is open with the EV button in the POWER ON position

li.p: When you turn the turn signal light on.

sectiondiv.p: If any of the following occurs, there may a malfunction with the turn signal system. In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

li.p: The indicator light does not blink but illuminates.
The indicator light blinks more rapidly.
The indicator light does not illuminate at all.
When the headlights are on.
When the headlights are on and in the high beam position.
When the turn signal lever is pulled into the Flash-to-Pass position.
When the high beam is on with the light switch in the AUTO light position.
If your vehicle detects oncoming or preceding vehicles, the High Beam Assist system automatically switches the high beam to low beam.
When the tail lights or headlights are on.
When the rear fog lights are on.
White: When you activate the AUTO HOLD system by pressing the AUTO HOLD button.
Green: When you stop the vehicle completely by depressing the brake pedal with the AUTO HOLD system activated.
Yellow: When there is a malfunction with the AUTO HOLD system.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Lane Safety indicator light
section.p: Lane Safety indicator light will illuminate when you turn Lane Keeping Assist on by pressing and holding Lane Driving Assist button.
If there is a problem with the function or deselect the Lane Safety, the yellow Lane Safety indicator light will illuminate.

section.title: Lane Following Assist indicator light
section.p: Lane Following Assist indicator will illuminate when you turn Lane Following Assist on by pressing Lane Driving Assist button.
If there is a problem with the function, the yellow Lane Following Assist indicator will illuminate.

li.p: When you select each mode as drive mode.

section.title: Intelligent Speed Limit Assist indicator light

li.p: When the EV button is in the POWER ON position. It illuminates for about 3 seconds and then goes off.
Yellow: When Intelligent Speed Limit Assist is off, disabled, or a malfunction is detected.

sectiondiv.p: If the yellow indicator light remains on after the front view camera has been uncovered or unblocked, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
For more information, refer to the .

li.p: When you set the EV button is in the POWER ON position. It illuminates for about 3 seconds and then goes off.
Green: When you activate the system by pressing the DBC button.
Yellow: Whenever a malfunction with the Downhill Brake Control system is detected.
If the yellow indicator light remains on, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
Green: When Downhill Brake Control system is operating.

section.title: Highway Lane Change Assist indicator light
section.sectiondiv:
This indicator light appears:
Green: When Highway Lane Change Assist is ready for operation.
Grey: When Highway Lane Change Assist is in standby.

li.p: Green: When Highway Lane Change Assist is operating.
White: When Highway Lane Change Assist is canceled.
